verdict.rationale: Cooley's emerging companies practice page states it handles 2,100+ VC financings annually with an even split between investor/company representation, is #1 for VC-backed IPOs, and Cooley GO's quarterly Venture Financing Report gives concrete deal volume (166 reported VC financings, $85.7B invested capital) plus #1 ranking for representing companies raising venture capital; seed-stage documentation (Series Seed package, YC SAFE generator) rounds out coverage from seed through late stage. Missing for 10: no independent/press corroboration of these self-reported stats beyond Cooley's own pages.
